content: Ananaias be Sapira
Tauḡoma tenaḡa isanama Ananaias, be na visarama Sapira, tauna mate adi doḡama tenaḡa ya gimare da
mane isunama tauna aubainama ya kaididi kwasena be mane isunama apasol ya utedina. Be na visarama Sapira tauna mate yai aninana.
Be Pita ya riuena, “Aba aubainama Seitan kuyai anine da nopomma yai moḡavu be Arua Babau ḡarone kuya kaiyovu be doḡa kuya gimagimarena manenama isudima tam aubaimma kuya rabe kwasedi?

Tam sibo doḡa kuya rabe kwasena bo doḡa kuya gimarena murine, mane sibo kuya rabe kwasena. Be aba aubainama uma kauinama nopome kuyai nuanoḡonoḡote be nama kuya voia? Tam nam banaga ḡarone ku kaiyovuna, ibewa da Mamaitua ḡarone kuya kaiyovuna.”
Raḡanine Ananaias nama giunama ya vaivaiedina, tauna ya beku be ya gurina. Be banaga aitauḡa inam nama kauinama a vaivaiena, taudi a naira kauana.
Raḡanine Ananaias ya gurigurina, dabudine yarayaraga a tava da a suma be a kiroḡa nawe da a dobona.
Suara ruvanama 3 awasnama a kovina murine, Ananaias na visarama ya tava be nam i kataiena da aba ya tubuḡa.
Pita yai taravirena, “Kwa riuegu, doḡa koya gimagimarena manenama, naumeki umanama, bo?” Be waivi ya riuna, “Ee, inam naumeki nama.”
Be Pita ya riuena, “Aba aubainama taumi koyai anina da Bada Aruinama koya raurubu? Banaga am tauḡomama a dobodobona, taudi matakedae tawai rabana da tam mate ta kiroḡa dobiḡemna.”
Naumeki da waivi yai raḡantenaḡe da Pita kaḡane ya beku be ya gurina. Dabudine yarayaraga a saḡa vadae, ta kitana be waivi ya gurina. Naumeki da a kiroḡa dobiḡe be na tauḡomama diane a dobona.
Be Mamaitua na damma matabudi be banaga ḡesaudima aitauḡa inam riunama a vaivaiena, taudi a naira kauana.
Apasol banaga toitoi ai yawasanidina
Apasol mataira be voia dosidima toitoi a voiedina banaga ḡarodie. Be tauwai sumaḡa matabudi kana raḡanie Solomon na wagapatae awai rawateḡeidina,
be banaga ḡesaudima nam waisumeḡidi taudi wairawateḡei a naira be yaḡoro banaga ḡesaudima a vivivivira kauedina.
Be tautauḡoma be waiwaivi ḡesaudima mate Bada awai sumaḡena, inam damnama nopone a saḡana.
Taudi banaga sidesidedima a kiroḡa nawedi kedae da vatara be guni debedie ai kenedina. Nama a voiana, baninama Pita ya veraverauna vagurunama sibo ya taukonidina.
Patara ḡesaudima Jerusalem diane meagaidima mate a rawateḡeidi, be banaga sidesidedi be banaga nopodie arua gewegewedima miemienidima mate a tavaitedina, be matabudi ai yawasanidina.
Apasol a raukivi gewegewedina
Dabudine pirisi adi badama be na banagama Sadisi mate taudi nopodima unura ya moḡavuna.
Taudi Apasol a panidi be dibure a biridina.
Be kupie Bada na aneama dibura matakedanama ya kaipore da yai doka dobiḡedi be ya riuedina,
“Ko naḡo, tempol nopone ko midi be uma yawasaninama vaunama, matabuna banaga ko riuedi!”

Raḡanine uma riunama a vaivaiena, taudi raḡantomtom a naḡo tempol nopone be waikatakatai ai karena. Pirisi adi badama be na banagama mate a tavana raḡanine, taudi boru isanama Sanedrion a voiena Israel babadidima mate. Dabudine banaga a riuporedina dibure, apasol waidokedima aubainama.
Raḡanine taudi dibure a tavatavana apasol nam ti banavidina, vutuna aubainama a munaḡa be babada ḡarodie ai maḡatara
be a riuna, “Dibura matakedanama gudugudu yaḡenama be taurabenama matakedae a midimidina. Be matakeda kè kaikaiporena raḡanine, nam aitau tenaḡa ke banavina.”
Raḡanine tempol taurabenama adi bada be pirisi adi babadama uma riunama a vaivaiena, taudi a nuababaḡa be nam ti kataiena aba tokare e tubuḡa.
Dabudine banaga tenaḡa ya tava be ya riuna, “Tautauḡoma dibure koya sivusivudina, taudi yodi tempol nopone ta midi be banaga tawai katakataidina.”
Dabudine tempol taurabedima adi badama mate a naḡo be apasol a verauḡedina. Be nam ti segeridina, baninama taudi a nairana banaga tima rauyekudi aubainama.
Apasol Sanedrion noḡodie nam giu ti nairana
Taudi apasol a verauḡedina Sanedrion noḡodie da pirisi adi badama ei taravireviredina.

Be tauna ya riuna, “Kè riu vavasaḡemina da taumi nam sibo Yesu isane koyai katakatai. Be taumi yaḡoro koyawai katakatai da uma riunama yodi Jerusalem noponama ya moḡavuna, be ko riuriuna da uma baneginama ya gurina wavunama tauma kabe ka kiroḡi.”
Be Pita apasol ḡesaudima mate a riuna, “Tauda Mamaitua sibo tè voteyeteyena, be nam banaga.
Taumi Yesu kai bogane koyai gurina, be tamatamadama adi Mamaituama tauna gurie be kawa midisuḡu munaḡena.

Be Mamaitua na rewapanae Yesu ya kawa midisuḡu da tauna Bada be Tauwai yawasana ya tubuḡana, baninama taune Mamaitua ya voie da Israel banegidima adi noḡotama ta vitaredi be adi gewagewama e noḡota poredina.
Tauma be Arua Babau inam kauidima kadi matamatama. Be aitauḡa Mamaitua a vovo teyeteyena, naumeki da taudi Arua Babau ya utedina.”
Gamaliel na raukurama
Raḡanine taudi umanama giunama a vaivaiena taudi nuedima yai medi kaua be waiguridima a ḡoena.

Be Parisi tenaḡa isanama Gamaliel, tauna tarawatu tauwai katakatainama be banaga matabudi tauna a vivivivirena. Naumeki da tauna Sanedrion nopone ya midisuḡu be ya riuedi da apasol doḡae a dobiḡedina raḡan ḡaubonaḡa.
Dabudine na banagama ya riuedina, “Israel babadimima taumi ko kita kaua da aba uma banegidima ḡarodie ko voiena.

Dokane nama tauḡoma isanama Tudas ya naḡomidisuḡu be ya riuna da tauna kabe banaga dosina, be banaga sievinama 400 nama ai muriwatanena. Be raḡanine tauna awai gurina, naumeki da tauwai muriwatana ai daberaridi be yaba matabuna ya kovina.
Be murine, Galili tauḡominama isanama Judas, tauna sensus raḡandie ya naḡomidisuḡu be banaga kourunama yai doka waigewedina. Be tauna mate ai gurina, be na tauwai muriwatanama mate ai daberaridina.
“Vutuna aubainama yodi yà rarau kuremina da uma tautauḡomidima ko gose poredi be ta naḡo. Baninama deḡoda adi noyama banage, tokare noyanama e bekuna,
be deḡoda Mamaituae, taumi tokare nam teneteneḡina da uma tautauḡomidima ko riutuaḡaiedi deḡoda taumi Mamaitua kowai ḡaviena.” Naumeki da inam babadidima taudi Gamaliel na raukurama a voteyeteyena.
Dabudine apasol ai doka saḡedi da kwapue a riḡedi, be a riu vavasaḡedina da nam Yesu isane ta giu munaḡa. Naumeki da a raukai gosedi be a naḡona.
Dabudine apasol ma nuavereveredi Sanedrion a gose porena, baninama Mamaitua ya vinedina da taudi teneteneḡinama da tai nuatoitoina Yesu isanama aubainama.
Be raḡan matabuna tempol be banaga adi vadama nopodiḡa waikatakatai nam ti gosena, be a rarau guguyana da Yesu tauna Tauwai yawasana.
